description: TalonHound bundled IOC threat classification taxonomy (built-in dictionary rows)

records.name: Unknown
records.description: Default when classification is unset or unrecognized.

records.name: Phishing
records.description: IOCs associated with phishing infrastructure, delivery, credential capture, or related social-engineering activity.

records.name: Credential Theft
records.description: IOCs linked to credential harvesting, theft, brute-force, or unauthorized account access activity.

records.name: Malware
records.description: IOCs associated with malicious software, payloads, or malware-related infrastructure not better classified elsewhere.

records.name: Ransomware
records.description: IOCs associated with ransomware operators, payloads, infrastructure, or delivery activity.

records.name: Command and Control (C2)
records.description: IOCs associated with command-and-control channels, botnet controllers, or C2 infrastructure.

records.name: Botnet
records.description: IOCs associated with botnet recruitment, control, or infected-host activity.

records.name: Exploit
records.description: IOCs associated with exploit delivery, exploitation infrastructure, or vulnerability abuse activity.

records.name: Scanner / Reconnaissance
records.description: IOCs associated with scanning, probing, or reconnaissance activity against targets.

records.name: Suspicious Infrastructure
records.description: IOCs linked to suspicious or abused hosting, proxies, anonymization, or compromised infrastructure.

records.name: Spam / Abuse
records.description: IOCs associated with spam campaigns, bulk abuse, or unsolicited malicious messaging.

records.name: Dropper / Downloader
records.description: IOCs associated with malware delivery, droppers, downloaders, or staging of secondary payloads.

records.name: Payload Hosting
records.description: IOCs that host malicious payloads, staged files, or weaponized content for delivery.

records.name: Data Exfiltration
records.description: IOCs associated with data theft, exfiltration channels, or staging of stolen data.

records.name: Cryptomining
records.description: IOCs associated with unauthorized cryptocurrency mining or cryptominer delivery.

records.name: Fraud / Scam
records.description: IOCs associated with fraud, scams, financial deception, or related criminal schemes.

records.name: Typosquatting / Impersonation
records.description: IOCs associated with typosquatting, brand impersonation, or deceptive domain activity.

records.name: Benign / Test
records.description: IOCs confirmed benign, used for testing, or non-malicious validation purposes.
